title: Auto Farm Mob Aura Quest God Mode No CD Stats Inf Lvl
features:
Main Farming

Auto Farm Level: Automatically grabs the best quest and teleports to mobs.
Auto Farm Selected Mob: Target specific enemies for drops or tasks.
Mob Aura / Magnet: Pulls all enemies into a stack for instant kills.
Fast Attack: Removes swing delay for massive DPS.
Auto Stats: Instant point allocation (Melee, Defense, Sword, Fruit).
Skill No Cooldown: Spam your abilities with zero wait time.

Fruit & Items

Fruit ESP & Notifier: See exactly where fruits spawn on the map.
Auto Collect Fruit: Instantly teleports to and grabs fruits.
Chest Farm: Automatically flies to all chests to farm money.
Auto Buy Items: Snipes specific items from shops or NPCs.

World & Teleports

Teleport To All Islands: Instant travel between any location in the game.
NPC Teleports: Quickly reach quest givers or trainers.
Infinite Stamina: Run and fly without ever getting tired.
Infinite Geppo: Jump infinitely into the sky.
Speed & Fly: Customizable movement speeds with bypass.

Mastery & Dungeon

Auto Mastery: Efficiently farms mastery for your Fruit or Sword.
Auto Dungeon / Anos: Automates the dungeon grind for rewards.
Auto Boss Farm: Cycles through bosses as they spawn.

Visuals & QoL

Player ESP: Wallhacks for all players (Name, Health, Distance).
Anti-AFK: Prevents being kicked for idling.
Server Hop: Quickly swap servers for boss resets.
Low Graphics Mode: Removes textures to boost FPS during long farms.
